{"consolidated_memory":"**Malformed Record Parser Issues in ingest/pipeline/parser.py: Seven Separate Occasions (2026-02-04 to 2026-07-26)**

All incidents involved decode errors pointing at a single byte offset in ingest/pipeline/parser.py (ingest side). All were reproduced with the mixed-encoding sample file. All occurred in the same corner of the parser code, with context carrying over between fixes.

**Occasion 1: [2026-02-04] Jobs Across Midnight Boundary**
- Trigger: Jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- Root cause: Connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Outcome: Job completed in 13 minutes instead of 2 hours
- Fix: Raised pool ceiling and added bounded wait queue in front of it
- PR #2798 on branch fix/malformed-record-1

**Occasion 2: [2026-04-20] Staging Read Replica**
- Trigger: Only on the staging read replica
- Root cause: Schema drift between the migration and the model
- Outcome: 74 duplicate rows per day stopped being written
- Fix: Regenerated model from migration and pinned the checksum
- PR #3340 on branch fix/malformed-record-2

**Occasion 3: [2026-05-08] After Client Retry**
- Trigger: Only after the client had already retried once
- Root cause: Unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Outcome: Throughput rose 61% to 186 requests per second
- Fix: Capped attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- PR #5773 on branch fix/malformed-record-3

**Occasion 4: [2026-05-20] Request Race on Same Key**
- Trigger: Only when two requests raced on the same key
- Root cause: Config loader reading the wrong environment file
- Outcome: Nightly rollup matched source counts for 68 days running
- Fix: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
- PR #8793 on branch fix/malformed-record-5

**Occasion 5: [2026-07-07] OAuth Provider Sessions**
- Trigger: Only for sessions that arrived through the OAuth provider
- Root cause: Cache entry that was never invalidated on write
- Outcome: Reclaimed 63 GB of blob storage
- Fix: Invalidated the entry inside the write transaction
- PR #8874 on branch fix/malformed-record-6

**Occasion 6: [2026-07-24] First Request After Cold Start**
- Trigger: Only on the first request after a cold start
- Root cause: Missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- Outcome: Backlog cleared 61 minutes after the deploy
- Fix: Normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
- PR #9208 on branch fix/malformed-record-7

**Occasion 7: [2026-07-26] Large Payloads**
- Trigger: Only for payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Root cause: Error swallowed by a bare except clause
- Outcome: Memory settled at 107 MB instead of climbing past 2 GB
- Fix: Narrowed the exception handler and let the failure propagate
- PR #9875 on branch fix/malformed-record-8"}
